title: In battle skill/item menu adjustment Code Help

posts.author: K-apple
posts.body:
I'm using Visustella's Frontview UI core but there are some changes I want to make that don't seem to be part of the plugin (or maybe it is and I can't find it.)
For starters I want to adjust the actor window and the item/skill windows that open up when you use the commands. I want the skill/item windows to parallel the actor command windows when you open them. Similar to this image below. (Potentially this could just be the item window as I could just add the skills to the main actor window.)
(Also is it possible to have the item window have two items per row instead of 1 but keep the actor window 1 command and 1 row? I tried looking but couldn't find that either.)
The 2nd issue is the Blue bar help window. I want to remove that because its honestly redundant as the help window at the top of the screen already explains what the item does and it causes the item window to move awkwardly as the game tries to fit all these boxes on the screen. Again, I don't know if the option to do all those things are part of the plug in natural, I just can't find it.
If anyone knows anything, I appreciate the help.
